original_question:
Let A ∈ GL_n(R) be invertible and let Γ ⊂ R^n be a full rank lattice. For ψ ∈ L2(R^n), define ψ_{j,k}(x) := |det A|^{j/2} ψ(A^j x − k) for j ∈ Z and k ∈ Γ. Call ψ an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A,Γ) if {ψ_{j,k} : j ∈ Z, k ∈ Γ} is an orthonormal basis of L2(R^n).

For what dilations A and lattices Γ does there exist an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A,Γ)?
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper's main target almost verbatim. It uses the same ambient space L^2(R^n), the same data A ∈ GL_n(R) and a full-rank lattice Γ ⊂ R^n, the same affine system ψ_{j,k}(x) = |det A|^{j/2} ψ(A^j x − k), and the same single-generator orthonormal-basis criterion from Definition 3.1. It also correctly does not impose extra hypotheses such as expansiveness, integrality of A, or |det A| ≠ 1, because Problem 3.1 itself is stated without those restrictions.
missing_details: The paper phrases this as a characterization problem for pairs (A, Γ), not merely an existence question in prose; the sharp stand-alone form should explicitly ask to characterize all such pairs.
To stay fully paper-faithful, the question should make clear that it concerns a single-generator orthonormal wavelet ψ, not the multiple-generator variant discussed elsewhere in Section 3.

The nearby Problem 3.2 is only a more concrete MSF/wavelet-set version, not a proved equivalent reformulation of Problem 3.1; the refined question should therefore not be rewritten as a wavelet-set problem.

The surrounding context notes that the lattice can be reduced to Z^n up to a linear change of variables when Γ = PZ^n, but the official problem is still stated for arbitrary full-rank lattices, so that scope should be preserved explicitly.

The paper also records that the hoped-for equivalence between orthonormal-wavelet existence and MSF-wavelet existence is still open because of the unresolved Calderón-formula problem; that hidden caveat explains why the question should remain exactly at the orthonormal-wavelet level.
refined_question: Characterize all pairs (A, Γ), where A ∈ GL_n(R) and Γ ⊂ R^n is a full-rank lattice, for which there exists a function ψ ∈ L^2(R^n) such that the affine system { |det A|^{j/2} ψ(A^j x − γ) : j ∈ Z, γ ∈ Γ } is an orthonormal basis of L^2(R^n).
justification: The draft is essentially the paper's Problem 3.1, after importing the notation of Definition 3.1. In Section 3, the paper first defines what it means for ψ to be an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A, Γ), and then in Section 3.2 asks exactly for a characterization of those dilation-lattice pairs for which such a ψ exists. The immediately following Problem 3.2 concerns existence of an (A, Γ)-wavelet set, i.e. the MSF version, but the paper explicitly says only that this is a more concrete version and that one expects Problems 3.1 and 3.2 to have the same answer; it does not prove equivalence, because the Calderón-formula Problem 3.3 remains open. Theorem 3.3 gives a complete answer only for the wavelet-set problem in dimension 2, and Theorem 3.4 gives an almost-every-lattice existence result for wavelet sets. Therefore the closest paper-faithful sharpening of your draft is simply a clean restatement of Problem 3.1 itself, without broadening it to wavelet sets or adding extra assumptions.
